command: Five-drone target sweep: Relief UAV 10, Relief UAV 09, Relief UAV 03, Relief UAV 04, and Relief UAV 08 take off together to 25 meters altitude. After reaching the targets, all five drones move west for 104m, then south for 108m, then north for 62m together. Each drone must complete the specified directional movements (west 104m, south 108m, north 62m) regardless of starting position - if obstacles block the path, drones should adjust position as needed to complete the full directed distance in each heading.
